title: Ivan Moreno
text:
Hello! 👋
-I’m an Economist and political scientist with 8+ years of experience implementing statistical tools for analysis and decision-making in NGOs, public and private sectors. Currently pursuing MSc in Development Economics at University of Göttingen with DAAD EPOS scholarship.
My approach combines quantitative analysis (R, Python, QGIS) with participatory fieldwork to create data-driven solutions for territorial development.

title: Ivan Moreno
text:
What I Do
🔍 Data Analysis & Geospatial Analysis - Statistical analysis and econometric modeling - Interactive dashboards and visualization (R, Shiny) - Territorial analysis and mapping (QGIS, Google Earth Engine)
🤝 Participatory Methodologies - Community engagement and workshop facilitation - Co-creation methodologies for rural development - Multi-stakeholder coordination processes
📊 Research & Policy - Survey design and analysis - Public policy evaluation and design - Academic research in development economics
